site.description: {{.Product}} is an open-source, self-hosted, AI-native workplace where AI employees and your team serve customers together.
site.hero_title: Put AI employees to work alongside your team
site.hero_body: Customer conversations, team chat, and AI employees in one workspace. AI employees respond first, hand off what they can't resolve to a teammate, and every interaction stays on record.
site.demo_customer: My order hasn't shipped yet. Can you check on it?
site.demo_agent_reply: Found it. The warehouse ships it this afternoon. Changing the address needs our after-sales team, so I'm handing you over.
site.demo_member_reply: Hi, your address is updated. We'll send the tracking number shortly.
site.features_title: One workspace for the whole service journey
site.features_body: From incoming messages to service reviews, AI employees and your team work in one place.
site.channels_body: Messages from your website widget, Telegram, and WeChat Official Accounts land in one shared inbox.
site.agents_body: Backed by knowledge bases, business tools, and connected computers, AI employees answer questions and get work done.
site.handoff_body: When AI can't resolve an issue, a teammate takes over, with assignment, timeouts, and summaries tracked in one place.
site.knowledge_body: Keep business knowledge in one place, cite sources in answers, and spot questions your knowledge base doesn't cover yet.
site.collaboration_body: Direct messages, group chats, contacts, and notifications keep your team in one app.
site.insights_body: Evaluate AI employee answers and track how AI and your team perform.
site.platforms_body: Web, desktop, and mobile apps connect to the same workspace, with messages synced in real time.
site.self_host_title: Keep your data on your own servers
site.self_host_body: {{.Product}} is open source. Deploy it on your own servers and keep full control of accounts, messages, and files.
site.pricing_title: Choose a plan for your team
site.pricing_body: Compare the features and prices of the available plans.
site.closing_body: Sign in to your workspace, or read the docs to learn more.
site.download_body: Install the desktop app and connect to this server to use {{.Product}}.
site.download_web: You can also use it in your browser without installing anything.
site.executor_body: Run the executor on a server or office computer and register it as a workspace computer for AI employees.
